handling: Direct archival without work-content or image screening. Archive all displayed source images without a size or six-image cap. Images whose bytes match the catalogue icon and whose original markup explicitly uses its 32x32 icon slot retain their inline-icon role. Screenshot-slot images remain in the gallery even when the catalogue also reuses them as icons. No natural-dimension filter is applied. Existing IDs and catalogue titles retained. No game package downloaded. Preserve 50 listed works and the original unnumbered auxiliary pages separately.
